data.name: Call of Girls
data.detailed_description:
Exclusive benefits

Launch Bonus: 8X8D5LAB288U5LYT (666 Diamonds, valid until April 7th)

In-game Bonus: 6VETFSPN67QGBMD7 (Value ¥188)

How to Redeem: Copy the redemption code above → Enter the game → Settings → Redeem Gift Pack → Enter the redemption code → Redeem → Receive in-game mail

Join Discord to receive an extra benefit


About the Game

Server Time: GMT+8

The rift originated from the mysterious "Heart of the Rift" and spread from the "Unknown Land."It continuously severs the bonds between worlds, causing them to collide and invade each other, ultimately leading to their complete annihilation.

As the Grand Chieftain, you will traverse different worlds: tracing the rift's trajectory, gradually sealing the source of corruption, uncovering the truth behind the Heart of the Rift, and preventing the final collapse of the worlds. On this journey, you will encounter two types of powerful enemies: The cloned powerhouses: mirror monsters created by the Heart of the Rift, replicating the top warriors of various worlds. They possess the original's skills but are twisted and made even more dangerous by the rift. The otherworldly powerhouses of the Rift faction: some are tempted by power, others bear the fate of their worlds, turning from allies into adversaries.

👑 Hundreds of Beautiful Girl Cards, Both Stylish and Powerful

This game features hundreds of unique anime female characters, from cool and aloof mature women to adorable lolis and valiant warriors. Each character boasts high-resolution artwork and exclusive dynamic effects, coupled with unique backstories and voice lines, making every collection a delightful surprise. Whether you're a collector focused on aesthetics or a power-hungry player, you'll find your perfect match.

📈 Multi-Dimensional Development System, Unlocking Infinite Possibilities

The comprehensive character development system covers multiple dimensions, including level progression, star upgrades, skill enhancements, and equipment forging, rejecting monotonous development! Each character has a unique development path that can be flexibly adjusted according to battle needs. This allows you to strengthen individual burst damage or refine team synergy, making your team adaptable to various battle scenarios and unlocking endless strategic possibilities.

👥 Star Alliance Guild Collaboration: Social Interaction and PvP Combined

Join a Star Alliance guild and journey alongside like-minded players! Share development resources, team up to challenge exclusive guild dungeons, and participate in guild leagues, forging bonds and rewards through cooperation. You can also exchange team composition tips within the guild, making your adventure less lonely.

⚔️ Diverse PvP/PvE Battles: Full of Strategy and Never Boring

A massive array of battle modes is coming, bidding farewell to monotonous dungeon cycles. Every battle is fresh and exciting!

Freely customize your team, cleverly utilizing character synergies and skill counters. There's no single strongest team, only the most strategic approach. Every battle offers the thrill of mental combat.

data.short_description: Call of Girls is a fantasy RPG centered around "character collection + idle gameplay + strategic combat," emphasizing high-quality art and a relaxed, long-term play experience. The game features a unique storyline for each character, enhancing the collection and immersive experience.

content_descriptors.notes:
The game contains some nudity or sexually explicit content, and there are scenes and images featuring characters in revealing clothing. Players are advised to choose carefully.
All characters in the game are rated 20 years and older.
